name: VAIL COMMERCIAL SAUNA
description:
Oversize Floor Heater Panels help create the perfect environment for hot yoga and stretching. Rounded cabin corners, radius roof element, and the beautiful black accent band across the front create the contemporary exterior design of the Vail.

The 2019 Vail commercial infrared sauna comes standard with a 30 hour programmable timer, full floor heater panels and integrated Bluetooth FMStereo with USB Port. The Flo-Thru Bench Seat is removable to allow standing and stretching in the large infrared sauna cabin.

 With a total of 42 square feet of Nano-Carbon™ infrared heater panel coverage, the Vail offers the most heater panel coverage available anywhere in a sauna this size. Bench seat is 4 feet wide. Seats two adults comfortably. Ideal business or personal sauna.

Black plexi-glass trim décor is not included on the side walls, but is only installed on the front panel, on either side of the door.
